name: Liam Fang
tagline: Learning Python via online selflearning website
about:
I'm working through freeCodeCamp's Python curriculum for VLD this year — mostly because I want a real, practical coding foundation before I apply to university, not because anyone assigned it to me. This site is my course log, my weekly reflection journal, and the evidence of what I've actually built along the way.

Everything here gets updated weekly. If a page looks stale, that's a fair thing to ask me about.
